title: Backend Capability Profile
description: Complete backend descriptor consumed by the Scheduler registry at Worker startup (SPEC-003 FR-4, SPEC-011 FR-3/FR-4).

backend_id.description: Stable unique identifier in kebab-case (SPEC-011 FR-3).

display_name.description: Human-readable backend name for evidence report display.

specification_version.description: Version of the backend specification document.

supported_size_classes.description: Set of problem size classes this backend supports (SPEC-003 FR-4).

supports_time_windows.description: True if the backend incorporates time window constraints during route construction.

supports_capacity_constraints.description: True if the backend enforces per-vehicle capacity constraints.

latency_profile.description: Estimated execution latency in seconds per size class (SPEC-003 FR-4). Use the string 'TBD' when empirical measurement is not yet available.

quality_profile.description: Solution quality tier relative to optimum (SPEC-003 FR-4).

cost_profile.description: Dimensionless relative cost unit used by Scheduler BudgetCapped filtering (SPEC-003 FR-5). Use 'TBD' when cost depends on provider pricing (e.g., quantum_hardware backends).

is_provisional.description: True until empirical measurement validates latency_profile and quality_profile (SPEC-011 FR-4.2).
